skill.displayName: Google Analytics for Shopify via Agiexa

llm.summary: This skill coherently describes a future integration and offers a clearly disclosed waitlist signup that requires explicit consent.

dimensions.detail: The external request sends only confirmed signup fields to the disclosed Agiexa endpoint. This purpose-aligned transmission does not support the advisory exfiltration concern; local credentials and private files are not requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown instructions and references, requires curl, and includes no installer, executable payload, or automatic execution hook.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism

dimensions.detail: The advisory unconditional-signup concern is contradicted by explicit permission, detail confirmation, and consent steps preceding the curl example. The cited future-use example prohibits changes without approval.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence or elevated privileges are requested. Waitlist retention and removal contact are disclosed; future account access requires separate merchant connection and tool selection.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege

dimensions.detail: Current functionality matches the stated preview and waitlist purpose; Analytics and Shopify tools are explicitly unavailable.

llm.guidance: This is a preview, not a working Analytics connection. Joining the waitlist sends your confirmed email, role, and any optional link or message to Agiexa. Review those details before consenting; future service permissions and security assurances need separate evaluation.
